macros.name: genericlabel
macros.doc: a generic macro \genericlabel{#1} which takes its argument #1 and puts it out on a label.

macros.name: LabelInfotrue
macros.doc: An optional grid overlay can be produced with the label output for testing purposes by the preamble control sequence \LabelInfotrue.

macros.name: LeftBorder
macros.doc: The values \LeftBorder and \RightBorder are amounts of white space to be added to the left and right of the actual label area so that the label itself does not smash into the edge of the grid.

macros.name: numberoflabels
macros.doc: To duplicate a label, there is a counter called \numberoflabels which you can set.

macros.name: RightBorder
macros.doc: The values \LeftBorder and \RightBorder are amounts of white space to be added to the left and right of the actual label area so that the label itself does not smash into the edge of the grid.

macros.name: skiplabels
macros.doc: The \skiplabels macro takes an integer argument of the number of empty labels to produce.

macros.name: TopBorder
macros.doc: \TopBorder is not the white space at the top of the page, but the amount of space to leave at the top so that the first label is centered on its grid.
